metadata.title: Optimized admin dashboard queries by consolidating multiple per-entity and per-metric COUNT queries into single aggregated database queries. This eliminates redundant DB round-trips caused by HTMX partial loading
metadata.author: Nayana-R-Gowda

description:

reviews.author: crivetimihai
reviews.body: Rebased and tested. Which issue does this close?

commits.message:
perf(admin): optimize dashboard queries by consolidating COUNT operations

Consolidate multiple per-entity and per-metric COUNT queries into single
aggregated database queries. This eliminates redundant DB round-trips.

Changes:
- Optimize observability stats: consolidate 4 separate count queries into
  a single SELECT with WHERE clause for index usage, then aggregate by status
- Optimize list endpoint count queries: use direct count on model with
  filters instead of counting from subquery alias
- Apply to tools, resources, prompts partial endpoints

Closes #1687

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
